title: A fallback world's rock country: one stretch at region size, or at country size
question: This world's country draw cleared no bar anywhere, so the guarantee grants it its best stretch anyway. Should that stretch be sized like a region (about half a screen, left pane at each position) or like a country (about two screens, right pane)? Which reads as 'a place you travel to'?
context_md:
Same world both sides: rolling seed 3, the 1-in-16 whose draw finds no rock country. Two camera positions per side, same cameras both sides (world x 7400 and 7900).

This is the §L fix: the old fallback admitted exactly the argmax region, which on the foraging scene's 512-wide world deleted the residual towers the colony forages over (98 round trips -> 2, the known-red-ascii job). Widening the fallback to the country field's own scale restores the scene (100 trips, bar 14) and, on shipped-size fallback worlds like this one, turns a half-screen cluster into the band you see. Gated worlds (15 of 16 seeds) are untouched.

If the band reads wrong, the scene fix needs a different lever -- say so and I will not argue.
